partners.mechanism_chain: MED12 (HGNC:11957) —DISRUPTS→ Transcription regulation by Mediator Complex (REACT:R-HSA-71286); Transcription regulation by Mediator Complex (REACT:R-HSA-71286) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Transcription regulation by Mediator Complex (REACT:R-HSA-71286) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal genitalia (HP:0000064).
